installed_odhen_source_facts: OrderDelivery action Cupom Fiscal calls OrderDeliveryController.geraNotaFiscal.
geraNotaFiscal calls DeliveryService.generatePayment after payment completeness checks.
The response handles IDSTATUSNFCE, mensagemNfce and mensagemImpressao and reports Venda realizada.
Reimpressao is a separate action and calls reprintDeliveryCupomFiscal.
Reprint path retrieves existing NRNOTAFISCALCE and imprimeDanfeNFCE; it is not the issuance path.
Payment sale code contains deadlock retry semantics that do not retransmit the fiscal note after transmission.

recent_real_order_readonly_observation.interpretation: Native fiscal sales are being created and authorized for real DLV_IFO orders in the current environment. This does not by itself prove whether an operator F7/Cupom Fiscal action was required for each transition.
